build_cmlm_transformer_model: build a CMLMNATransformerModel for constant-time machine translation using conditional masked language models
run_forward_training: run the CMLMNATransformerModel forward pass to encode source tokens and predict word insertions and length
run_forward_decoder_inference: run the forward_decoder method to iteratively unmask tokens during non-autoregressive decoding with skeptical unmasking
review_skeptical_unmasking: review the _skeptical_unmasking function that computes a skeptical mask based on output scores and boundary length
configure_cmlm_base_architecture: configure the cmlm_base_architecture function to set encoder and decoder hyperparameters for the CMLM transformer model
